Question
========
What is source-based plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* missing references
* using incorrect or fake sources
* copying someone else's work without citing
* using someone else's data and/or experiment design to draw different conclusions or refute their theories and claims


Solution
========
Source-based plagiarism involves incorrect or fake sources.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
